summary: Fixed cross-session claim lookup in gate. Added /overlay/claim-session POST endpoint in routes/overlay.js that stores claimSessions[task_key]=session_id on the overlay; cleans up on done/tested/failed/canceled transitions. Added third lookup in /active-claim in routes/session.js that checks ov.claimSessions for matching session IDs (after subagent alias lookup). Created hooks/orch-posttool-starttask.sh PostToolUse hook that fires after every start_task call and registers the claim via the new endpoint. Wired the hook into .claude/settings.json PostToolUse array.
Rewrote README with DAG=RAG + token-mindful framing, fixed diagram, added benchmark section, moved MCP tables to bottom.

Rewrote README.md: headline → behavioral outcome ("knows what it knows, what it costs, when memory pays"), before/after comparison block, DAG=RAG + token-aware + receipts bullets, unified-graph diagram replacing two-box diagram, new Evidence section with held-out wins + contamination retraction disclosure, renamed self-learning → self-improvement loop. MCP tables kept intact at bottom.

Judge-to-dispatcher messaging architecture: (1) judge skill updated to call send_message to DISPATCHER_SESSION instead of surfaceCluster for ambiguous clusters; (2) orch-loop skill updated to pass DISPATCHER_SESSION when spawning judge, ask user inline, resolve via /judge/verdict with consolidate or markDistinct; (3) routes/judge.js: added markDistinct verdict that calls markClusterDistinct + stampCluster without creating a guidance item. Dashboard popup already stripped of review items (prior task).
